Sam (config): Quick kickoff: we need a tiny preview + artifact flow for bulk runtime changes (routing/quotas). Goal: let product teams generate a shareable preview token, run basic safety checks, and optionally replay in staging. What fields are must-haves?

Rae (console): Minimal: preview_id, summary (changed paths + counts), affected_tenant_estimate, and a small human estimate string. Dry-run only. Console returns artifact JSON and preview ttl.

Diego (sre): Safety gates: max batch 500 keys by default, require ops ack >2k tenants. Canary default 1% x 30m. Auto-pause if any shard sees >1% absolute 5xx uplift in 10m. Also advisory locks: visible in UI/API, 409 on conflict.

Ivy (telemetry): Preview needs baseline_snapshot_id capturing rps_1m, p95, and 5xx_rate per-tenant. During apply tag traffic with X-Preview-Id so traces can be sliced. We'll emit a tiny preview_report every 60s for first 20m: lines like preview_id|metric:baseline:current:delta_pct.

Sam (config): Example call we envision: POST /api/v1/config/preview body with changes + dry_run=true -> response {preview_id, snapshot_id, estimate}. Console should surface a 2-col diff, timeline, and "fork to staging" replay button.

Rae (console): UX: two-col diff, approvals widget, export JSON button. We'll also add a confirm modal that shows auto-pause thresholds and batch size warnings before apply.

Diego (sre): Runbook: canary steps and cooldowns (default 45m between ramps). For patches touching >10k tenants, require ops war-room. I'll draft the snippet.

Ivy (telemetry): Collector changes: add lightweight index by preview_id and TTL it with artifact. Also spike up sampling to 10% for first minute of a canary apply. PR incoming.

infra-bot: Note: config ingest maintenance scheduled 2024-08-10 01:00-02:00 UTC. Avoid mass applies then.

Sam (config): Action items: Rae -> implement /config/preview endpoint + returning artifact (POC by EOD Tue). Ivy -> collector tag + preview_report proto. Diego -> runbook + thresholds. I'll own retention policy (30d default). Put preview_id:1777654321 in PRs.

Rae (console): Ack.

Ivy (telemetry): On it.

Diego (sre): Will send runbook.
